snippet.title: Mecha Legends - Official New Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175790/Mecha_Legends/

Mecha Legends As the pilot of a massive mechanical armor, you will face powerful dragons and dangerous creatures dwelling in the darkest corners of the world. Customize your mecha: Change its appearance, weapons, and abilities!

Developer: Animanicks 

#indiegame #mecha #rpg #action
